title: Migrate clipped images to Cloudflare R2 if the inbox repository (CristianDeluxe/brain-clips) nears ~1 GB
notes: the real cost: rewriting asset paths does not shrink history, so reclaiming
space needs `git filter-repo`, a force-push and a re-clone everywhere.
Checked 2026-10-11: the inbox repository reports 413 MB (`gh api
empties it on every run; the archive moved to the wiki. No images are
clipped yet (phase 3), so the trigger is still far off.
Re-measured 2026-10-11 later: 423301 KB (~413 MiB) by the same `gh api`
call; unchanged, well under the ~1 GB trigger.

2026-11-24 audit: not done, trigger not reached. Re-measured today: gh api user/repos shows CristianDeluxe/brain-clips size 423301 KB (~413 MiB), identical to 2026-10-11, so ~41% of the 1 GB trigger. Note: the extension now has an optional "Download images" setting (docs/chrome-web-store.md), off by default, so growth could start; no R2 code exists. Next step: re-run the size check at check_on and only plan the R2 move (plus git filter-repo/force-push/re-clone) if above ~800 MB.
